answer: Copying the same citations across 142 aliases therefore forfeits the reading cost 142 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the cipher check immediately, the summit audit keeps the resolved set and the zenith replay reveals exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
